fields.name: schema_version
fields.about: version of THIS contract; a reader that does not know it should say so rather than guess

fields.name: case_id
fields.about: unique per case

fields.name: family
fields.about: 'plain' or the component archetype

fields.name: design
fields.about: 'ofat' (one axis varied from the baseline) or 'lhs' (joint sample); the two answer different questions and must not be pooled without saying so

fields.name: git_sha
fields.about: commit the run was produced at

fields.name: produced_at
fields.about: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601

fields.name: R
fields.about: stinger radius, to the ROLLER CENTRELINE

fields.name: spacing
fields.about: roller spacing

fields.name: OD
fields.about: pipeline outside diameter

fields.name: t_wall
fields.about: pipeline wall thickness

fields.name: tension_mt
fields.about: lay tension in METRIC TONNES; the solver works in newtons (x 9806.65)

fields.name: L_comp
fields.about: component length; 0 for plain pipe

fields.name: L_OD
fields.about: component length in pipe diameters

fields.name: t_ratio
fields.about: component wall over pipe wall

fields.name: contact_surface
fields.about: 'centreline' (pipe centreline driven onto the R arc) or 'bottom' (R + r_roller + OD/2); they differ by about 1%

fields.name: mode
fields.about: 'A' carries state between positions (the real path, and the only mode that accumulates plasticity); 'B' solves each from virgin

fields.name: material
fields.about: 'j2', 'ro' or 'elastic'

fields.name: step
fields.about: sweep step: the travel between sampled positions. Edge crossings are solved regardless of it, so the envelope does not depend on it (a whole-element step alone was 16% low)

fields.name: stiffness_ratio
fields.about: component second moment over pipeline second moment, off the SOLVED sections; 1.0 when nothing steps

fields.name: contact_lift_max
fields.about: deepest CENTRELINE LIFT the component applies above the plain-pipe baseline. FOR A SHROUD THIS IS THE ENTIRE COMPONENT: GD-SH adds no bending stiffness, so without this column its case is indistinguishable from bare pipe. Measured 0.20320 m for GD-SH (= V - OD/2), 0.04400 for GD-TT, 0.02100 for GD-TP

fields.name: contact_lift_station
fields.about: roller under the deepest lift, over the whole passage

fields.name: contact_lift_step
fields.about: position index at which that lift was reached. At the LEADING EDGE of a tapered component the lift is correctly ZERO, so a single position proves nothing

fields.name: comp_s_lead
fields.about: component LEADING (stinger-side) edge in STATION coordinates, at the envelope position. Without it a reader has the component's length but not where it was

fields.name: comp_s_trail
fields.about: component TRAILING (vessel-side) edge, station coordinates, at the envelope position

fields.name: junction_snapshot_step
fields.about: position index the junction SNAPSHOT columns were taken at (the bare `j*` names; the `_env` ones are over all positions)

fields.name: junction_snapshot_shift
fields.about: travel at that position

fields.name: n_junctions
fields.about: section steps in the model; 0 for plain pipe and for a component that shares the pipe section

fields.name: n_positions
fields.about: positions the passage scheduled

fields.name: n_converged
fields.about: positions that converged

fields.name: zone_s_max
fields.about: reporting band cut, in STATION coordinates; everything at or beyond it is excluded (the D6 tip artefact)

fields.name: zone_label
fields.about: which stations the band drops

fields.name: start_strain
fields.about: peak strain at the START position -- what a single-position solve would have reported

fields.name: peak_strain
fields.about: peak extreme-fibre strain in the reporting band (a FRACTION: 0.0074 is 0.74%), worst over the whole passage

fields.name: peak_strain_s_material
fields.about: material coordinate of peak extreme-fibre strain in the reporting band (a FRACTION: 0.0074 is 0.74%) -- labels a point on the PIPE and travels with it

fields.name: peak_strain_s_station
fields.about: station coordinate of peak extreme-fibre strain in the reporting band (a FRACTION: 0.0074 is 0.74%) -- where on the STINGER, and the coordinate to compare across positions

fields.name: peak_strain_station
fields.about: nearest roller to peak extreme-fibre strain in the reporting band (a FRACTION: 0.0074 is 0.74%)

fields.name: peak_strain_station_offset
fields.about: signed distance from that roller, + toward the stinger

fields.name: peak_strain_step
fields.about: passage position index at which peak extreme-fibre strain in the reporting band (a FRACTION: 0.0074 is 0.74%) occurred

fields.name: peak_strain_shift
fields.about: travel along the passage at that position

fields.name: peak_moment
fields.about: peak bending moment magnitude in the reporting band, worst over the whole passage

fields.name: peak_moment_s_material
fields.about: material coordinate of peak bending moment magnitude in the reporting band -- labels a point on the PIPE and travels with it

fields.name: peak_moment_s_station
fields.about: station coordinate of peak bending moment magnitude in the reporting band -- where on the STINGER, and the coordinate to compare across positions

fields.name: peak_moment_station
fields.about: nearest roller to peak bending moment magnitude in the reporting band

fields.name: peak_moment_station_offset
fields.about: signed distance from that roller, + toward the stinger

fields.name: peak_moment_step
fields.about: passage position index at which peak bending moment magnitude in the reporting band occurred

fields.name: peak_moment_shift
fields.about: travel along the passage at that position

fields.name: body_peak_strain
fields.about: peak strain ON THE COMPONENT BODY, worst over the whole passage

fields.name: body_peak_strain_s_material
fields.about: material coordinate of peak strain ON THE COMPONENT BODY -- labels a point on the PIPE and travels with it

fields.name: body_peak_strain_s_station
fields.about: station coordinate of peak strain ON THE COMPONENT BODY -- where on the STINGER, and the coordinate to compare across positions

fields.name: body_peak_strain_station
fields.about: nearest roller to peak strain ON THE COMPONENT BODY

fields.name: body_peak_strain_station_offset
fields.about: signed distance from that roller, + toward the stinger

fields.name: body_peak_strain_step
fields.about: passage position index at which peak strain ON THE COMPONENT BODY occurred

fields.name: body_peak_strain_shift
fields.about: travel along the passage at that position

fields.name: body_peak_moment
fields.about: peak bending moment magnitude on the component body, worst over the whole passage

fields.name: body_peak_moment_s_material
fields.about: material coordinate of peak bending moment magnitude on the component body -- labels a point on the PIPE and travels with it

fields.name: body_peak_moment_s_station
fields.about: station coordinate of peak bending moment magnitude on the component body -- where on the STINGER, and the coordinate to compare across positions

fields.name: body_peak_moment_station
fields.about: nearest roller to peak bending moment magnitude on the component body

fields.name: body_peak_moment_station_offset
fields.about: signed distance from that roller, + toward the stinger

fields.name: body_peak_moment_step
fields.about: passage position index at which peak bending moment magnitude on the component body occurred

fields.name: body_peak_moment_shift
fields.about: travel along the passage at that position

fields.name: status
fields.about: 'ok', 'partial n/m', or 'FAILED'; a case that did not fully converge is RECORDED, never dropped

fields.name: error
fields.about: reason, when it failed

fields.name: seconds
fields.about: wall-clock solve time

fields.name: n_active
fields.about: contact slots active at the envelope position

fields.name: n_slots
fields.about: contact slots in all

patterns.name: s_[A-Za-z]+\d*
patterns.about: ARC POSITION of that station along the stinger. Without these a consumer has `eps_SR2_env` but no way to place SR2, and deriving it from `spacing` assumes a layout the file never states

patterns.name: eps_[A-Za-z]+\d*_env
patterns.about: worst strain at that station over the whole passage (MAX over positions, never a sum)

patterns.name: j\d+_at_(pipe|component|na)_strain(_env)?
patterns.about: strain at a junction, on the named side; bare name is the SNAPSHOT at the envelope position, `_env` the worst at any position

patterns.name: j\d+_at_(pipe|component|na)_moment(_env)?
patterns.about: bending moment at a junction, on the named side

patterns.name: j\d+_at_(pipe|component|na)_s
patterns.about: material coordinate of that junction probe

patterns.name: j\d+_at_(pipe|component|na)_clamped
patterns.about: the section run ended before the requested point, so this is the nearest available datum rather than the requested one

patterns.name: j\d+_[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD_strain(_env)?
patterns.about: strain at an offset from a junction, in pipe diameters; `m` is toward the vessel, `p` toward the stinger

patterns.name: j\d+_[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD_moment(_env)?
patterns.about: bending moment at an offset from a junction

patterns.name: j\d+_[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD_s
patterns.about: material coordinate of that offset probe

patterns.name: j\d+_[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD_clamped
patterns.about: clamped to the nearest available datum

patterns.name: j\d+_(at_(pipe|component|na)|[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD)_side
patterns.about: which BODY the probe landed in -- 'pipe' or 'component'. Without it a consumer cannot tell which side of a section step a probe is on, and a profile drawn from the file connects points across a discontinuity that strain genuinely has

patterns.name: j\d+_(at_(pipe|component|na)|[mp]\d+(\.\d+)?OD)_owner
patterns.about: the component that owns the surface there, or `pipe`
